problem:
For the function $f:{R}^{2}\to R,$ defined as

$$
f(x,y)=(x-y)^{3},
$$

the quadratic Taylor polynomial of $f$ about $a=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 1\end{aligned}]$ is given by

$$
f(x,y)≈f(a)+{f}^{′}(a)(x-a)+\frac{1}{2}{[\begin{aligned}∗ \\ y-1\end{aligned}]}^{T}[\begin{aligned}-6 & ∗ \\ 6 & -6\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ ∗\end{aligned}].
$$

Find the sum of the three missing expressions.
